messages:
PM_Tasha: heads-up — got a major customer request today: they want a single chat flow to fan out to multiple external integrations (search, db-lookup, payment-quote) and then merge results, but with different timing/priority guarantees. asking for product constraints + launch checklist. :eyes:
EngLead_Ravi: can you paste the exact asks? are they requiring strict ordering or just best-effort aggregation?
PM_Tasha: key bullets from the customer: 1) must return partial answers quickly (stream if available), 2) some calls are critical (payment-quote) and must be retried aggressively, 3) search can be soft and stale fallback ok, 4) overall latency budget 2s for first partial, 5s for full merge, 4) observability per-action + per-request SLA breakdown.
Ben_Runtime: ok. sounds like we need a graded parallel-invoke model: prioritize lanes (critical, best-effort, background), per-lane retry budgets and per-invoke deadlines. also need a way to cancel lower-priority calls once the critical lane finishes and meets downstream need.
Carla_PM: agree. customers keep saying they want "predictable" cost & latency. if we explode retries for every call that kills cost. need default retry budgets and toggles for enterprise.
SRE_Juan: from an SRE POV: we need circuit-breakers and per-invocation backpressure signals to avoid queuing storms. also metrics: per-invoke latency, retries, success-rate, and token-cost attribution across merged responses.
Design_Lina: UX question: how do we expose merged outputs? a single streamed response that labels chunks by origin? or structured merged JSON? customer prefers structured with provenance so they can display partial cards.
EngLead_Ravi: proposal sketch 
```
invoke_model({
  calls: [
    {id: "quote", target: "payment-api", lane: "critical", deadline_ms: 3000, retry_budget: 3},
    {id: "search", target: "semantic-search", lane: "best-effort", deadline_ms: 4000, retry_budget: 1},
    {id: "kb", target: "internal-kv", lane: "background", deadline_ms: 8000, retry_budget: 0}
  ],
  merge_strategy: "priority-merge", // options: priority-merge | first-complete | union
  stream_partial: true
})
```
Ben_Runtime: merging semantics matter. priority-merge = emit critical lane results asap, then enrich with others when available. need stable ties: if two lanes produce conflicting structured fields, do we keep highest-lane value or latest? add a conflict resolution policy param.
PM_Tasha: add param `conflict_policy: "lane-precedence"` for now. we can offer custom resolver later.
SRE_Juan: we also need cancellation semantics explicit: when merge_strategy hits quality threshold, lower-priority calls should receive a cancel signal; define cancel vs allow-to-finish.
Carla_PM: customer will want audit logs for cancelled calls for compliance. include per-call status in response envelope.
EngLead_Ravi: proto for response envelope idea:
```
{
  request_id: "r-123",
  partials: [
    {call_id: "quote", status: "ok", lanes: "critical", latency_ms: 210, result: {...}},
    {call_id: "search", status: "cancelled", lanes: "best-effort", latency_ms: 1200}
  ],
  merged: {...},
  cost_breakdown: {tokens: 420, external_calls: 3}
}
```
Design_Lina: streaming UX note: if we stream partials, include a header frame naming the lane and origin so client can render incremental cards. e.g., `[lane=critical|source=payment-api]` then payload chunk.
Ben_Runtime: implementation concerns: continuous batching and rate limiting for external integrations, and per-tenant quotas. we should avoid sync-blocking on slow external calls — use async invoke with tokenized KV cache for repeatable lookups.
SRE_Juan: also need SLAs per lane, e.g., critical lane SLO 99.9 p50<200ms, p95<800ms. expose alerting hooks when retries exceed thresholds.
PM_Tasha: launch criteria suggestion: 
- API contract stable and documented (examples + merge strategies)
- Default safe retry budgets and cost controls set for self-serve
- Observability shipped: per-call metrics, per-request envelope logs, sampling for payloads
- Cancellation/audit logs enabled for enterprise
- e2e test harness with simulated slow/failed downstreams

Carla_PM: timeline: Q2 beta with enterprise toggle, Q3 GA if no major regressions. need to validate with 2 customers in beta.
EngLead_Ravi: low-risk MVP: implement lanes + per-call deadlines + merge_strategy=first-complete | priority-merge, stream partials, and include envelope. defer custom conflict resolvers and aggressive hedging to post-MVP.
Ben_Runtime: I'll prototype runtime flow and a small devkit for mocking external adapters. CC @ops-bot to spin a test stack?
ops-bot: deploy job started: `deploy/parallel-invokes/proto` — staging cluster being prepared. :rocket:
SRE_Juan: I'll draft SLOs and alerting playbook. will add tags to metrics for lane and call_id.
Design_Lina: I'll mock UX cards and incremental render flow this week.
PM_Tasha: thanks everyone. action items: Ravi owns API spec, Ben runtime prototype, Juan SLO + observability, Lina UX mocks, Carla coordinate beta customers. please update the product doc with acceptance tests by Friday. :white_check_mark:
Ben_Runtime: quick question — how do we want to represent `retry_budget` semantics? token count or number of attempts? I'd prefer attempts count for now.
Carla_PM: attempts count is easier to explain to customers. note default 1 attempt for best-effort, 2 for background, 3 for critical. editable per-tenant.
EngLead_Ravi: noted. we'll include per-call headers for billing attribution.
PM_Tasha: end-to-thread — follow-ups in the product doc.
